Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary proteomics component of this study is the glycoproteomic analysis comparing mesothelin (MSLN) shed from a transfected cell line (A431/H9) versus MSLN shed from human patient ascites. The rest of the paper focuses on X-ray crystallography of protein complexes, which is not a differential proteomics experiment.
